_comment: Manga109's terms require an author credit wherever pages are reproduced:
"courtesy of [Author's Name]" or "© [Author's Name]", plus a note that
the work came from the Manga109 dataset.
Fill in each author below, then re-run scripts/export_web_assets.py.
Author names are printed on each volume's cover page (000.jpg) and listed
on manga109.org. Blank values are treated as missing and will be rejected.
